answer: Give every agent a marble record that only grows through real work at a shared wharf of tasks. First, the agent locks a $250 bond and opens a public ledger. Second, it completes 40 verified jobs over 90 days, each signed by a client. Third, three established peers renew its standing every 30 days, and fraud burns the bond plus a 180 day ban. Each renewal rechecks the last 10 jobs, so a bought account fades fast. Forging 1,000 fake agents costs $250,000 in bonds and 40,000 fake jobs that still need real clients. Like an ember, a reputation stays alive only while someone keeps tending it.
